## Checklist

- [ ] Security-relevant? Added/updated an attack in `apps/api/kym/redteam.py`

- [ ] Simulated behaviour is labelled as simulated; no compliance/certification claims added
- [ ] No secrets, real personal data or real financial data
- [ ] UI changes: `tsc`, `eslint`, `next build` pass; screenshot attached
- [ ] Commits signed off (`git commit -s`)
